description: A Flot plugin for stacking data sets in graphs, enabling accumulative visualizations by modifying datapoints to stack series with the same 'stack' attribute.

methods.name: findMatchingSeries
methods.description: Finds a series in allseries that matches the stack attribute of a given series.

methods.name: stackData
methods.description: Processes datapoints to stack series with the same 'stack' attribute, modifying their y-values accordingly.
